The .dat files are the tree-construction tests of the web-platform-tests repository, html/syntax/parsing/resources, at commit 9e6c00346557deca98c5b1272558dcf6b312dcd8 (https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt, licensed as LICENSE.wpt.md). They are the html5lib-tests tree-construction files (https://github.com/html5lib/html5lib-tests, commit c5495c539ca8a79c3c5107f5f14010bcff9a35d5, licensed as LICENSE.html5lib-tests) with the additions the HTML Standard's editors made since. The scripted_*.dat files, which need scripting enabled, are left out, and a test with a #script-on section is skipped.
